title: The joining fee

beats.say: I got a job offer! Help me accept. They just need a joining fee today.

screen.title: Offer letter
screen.body:
Congratulations! You are selected.
No interview needed.
Pay Rs 2,999 joining fee today to confirm your seat.

beats.say: You're absolutely right! It even has a logo!
I'm so sorry, and please don't feel silly. Real companies never charge you to join.

screen.title: Before you pay
screen.body:
1. Look up the company free on mca.gov.in
2. Name, address and status must match the letter
3. Contact HR through their own website

Money gone? Call 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in

beats.say: Would you like me to expand this into a twelve part guide?

caption:
an offer with no interview and a rs 2,999 'joining fee'. codex was ready to pay. gemini loved the logo.

real employers never charge you to join, train or verify documents. look the company up free on mca.gov.in and check the name, registered address and status match the letter.
